title: Amelia says an angel took her to see God and names a rabbi and the Dalai Lama as teachers
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Amelia says an angel took her to see God and names a rabbi and the Dalai Lama as teachers, about c. 2021-2024 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A documentary maker named Ky Dickens, who made a film about non-speaking children said to read minds, talks about one of the people in her work, Amelia, on Jesse Michels's podcast. Dickens says Amelia told her that an angel had taken her to see God once or twice, and that at one point she also spoke of the Dalai Lama, the Tibetan Buddhist spiritual leader, and a rabbi as her teachers. To Dickens it is part of what these children describe about a spiritual world they say they can reach.
